scope: Pinned SysML XMI internal discrepancies encountered during the state-query audit. No normative source is amended; related historical resolutions do not by themselves close the listed pinned-artifact discrepancies.

items.name: validateTransitionFeatureMembershipGuardExpression
items.expression: kind = TransitionFeatureKind::guard implies     transitionFeature.oclIsKindOf(Expression) and     let guard : Expression = transitionFeature.oclIsKindOf(Expression) in     guard.result.specializesFromLibrary('ScalarValues::Boolean') and     guard.result.multiplicity <> null and     guard.result.multiplicity.hasBounds(1,1)
items.comment: If the kind of a TransitionUsage is guard, then its transitionFeature must be a kind of Expression whose result is a Boolean value.
items.finding: Local guard is assigned the Boolean oclIsKindOf result and then accessed as an Expression.

items.name: deriveStateUsageDoAction
items.expression: doAction =     let doMemberships : Sequence(StateSubactionMembership) =         ownedMembership->             selectByKind(StateSubactionMembership)->             select(kind = StateSubactionKind::do) in     if doMemberships->isEmpty() then null     else doMemberships->at(1)     endif
items.comment: The doAction of a StateUsage is the action of the owned StateSubactionMembership with kind = do.
items.finding: State slot property/prose require an ActionUsage, while the expression returns a StateSubactionMembership.

items.name: deriveTransitionUsageGuardExpression
items.comment: The triggerActions of a TransitionUsage are the transitionFeatures of the ownedFeatureMemberships of the TransitionUsage with kind = trigger, which must all be Expressions.
items.finding: Guard derivation selects trigger memberships rather than guard memberships.

items.name: deriveTransitionUsageEffectAction
items.comment: The effectActions of a TransitionUsage are the transitionFeatures of the ownedFeatureMemberships of the TransitionUsage with kind = effect, which must all be ActionUsages.
items.finding: Effect derivation assigns triggerAction and selects trigger memberships/AcceptActionUsage rather than effect actions.

relatedIssues.relevance: Introduced the trigger constraint for transition sources that are not StateUsages; corroborates testing source metaclass identity independently of action referents.
Changed transition source/target derivations to use Feature.featureTarget for chains, consistent with the pinned derivations consumed by the checked endpoint proof.
The published disposition corrects effectAction attribute wording. It does not establish a correction to the copied effect derivation expression still present in the pinned XMI.

Identifies self-redefinition problems in the normative library entry/do/exit declarations. This is a distinct unresolved library concern, not a resolution of the six state-slot expression discrepancies.

reviewLimit: The focused issue search did not establish a directly matching resolution for the six state-slot expression type mismatches or the guard derivation/validation expression problems. This is not a claim that no related issue exists.
